say:0:1123201001:0.text: It seems it's been a while since we last visited Hashir.
say:0:1123201001:0.source_cn: 好像离上次拜访哈什尔已经有段时间了……

say:1:1123201002:0.text: Magister, should we go and see him?
say:1:1123201002:0.source_cn: 主人，我们是不是该去看看哈什尔了？
say:1:1123201002:0.male: Magister, should we go and see him?
say:1:1123201002:0.female: Magister, should we go and see him?

say:0:1123202001:0.text: Stop it! What are you doing, you dumb clod? You're hurting him!
say:0:1123202001:0.source_cn: 住手！你这笨熊在干什么！你弄疼它了！

say:2:1123202003:0.text: Of course, the creature will resist if you're rough with it! You need to build trust!
say:2:1123202003:0.source_cn: 你这样粗鲁它当然会反抗！你需要跟它建立信任！

say:2:1123203001:1.text: What should I do? He ran away!
say:2:1123203001:1.source_cn: 我、我该怎么做，它跑掉了！

say:3:1123203002:1.text: I'd run away too if I were in his place!

choice_prompt:4:1123203002.text: I'd run away too if I were in his place!

say:5:1123203003:1.text: My lizard got startled for some reason and crashed into this elder's tent... I didn't know how to make him stop!
say:5:1123203003:1.source_cn: 我的蜥蜴不知道因为什么受惊了，还撞破了这位老人的帐篷，...

say:6:1123203004:1.text: He was only curious. Your actions just now are what startled him. Do you understand?
say:6:1123203004:1.source_cn: 它并不是受惊，而是看到什么好奇的东西，是你刚才的动作让...

say:7:1123203005:1.text: I cannot fathom how someone as clumsy as you became a beast tamer.
say:7:1123203005:1.source_cn: 真搞不懂你这种笨熊是怎么当上驯兽师的？

say:8:1123203006:1.text: I-I'm sorry. What should I do now?

say:9:1123203007:1.text: Go bother someone else. I don't have the patience to teach you.
say:9:1123203007:1.source_cn: 问问别人吧，我可没闲心教你。

choice_prompt:10:1123203007.text: Go bother someone else. I don't have the patience to teach you.
choice_prompt:10:1123203007.source_cn: 问问别人吧，我可没闲心教你。

say:11:1123203008:1.text: Hmph! I just wanted to yell at him a bit.
say:11:1123203008:1.source_cn: 哼，我只是想骂他几句而已。

say:12:1123203009:1.text: No! My lizard is about to escape! If the clan finds out... well, it won't be good!
say:12:1123203009:1.source_cn: 不，不！我的蜥蜴要跑掉了，如果让氏族知道我一定会受罚的！

choice_prompt:13:1123203009.text: No! My lizard is about to escape! If the clan finds out... well, it won't be good!
choice_prompt:13:1123203009.source_cn: 不，不！我的蜥蜴要跑掉了，如果让氏族知道我一定会受罚的！

say:14:1123203010:1.text: Forget it, that lizard is long gone.
say:14:1123203010:1.source_cn: 省省吧，那只蜥蜴已经跑远了。

say:15:1123203011:1.text: Unless... you make good use of other small animals. Perhaps you could draw its attention.
say:15:1123203011:1.source_cn: 除非……你们利用好其他小动物的话，也许还能吸引回它的注意力。

say:1:1123204001:0.text: He calmed down! Thank you so much! But... your tent...
say:1:1123204001:0.source_cn: 它安静下来了！非常感谢！不过……您的帐篷……

say:2:1123204002:0.text: What? You want to disturb me even as I fix my tent? Get out of here!
say:2:1123204002:0.source_cn: 怎么？你这笨蛋还想打扰我修帐篷吗？快走吧！

say:3:1123204003:0.text: Thank you... thank you all. I won't forget your help.
say:3:1123204003:0.source_cn: 感谢，感谢你们……我不会忘记你们的帮助。

say:5:1123204004:0.text: You really think you're doing that clumsy fool any favors by helping him so much?
say:5:1123204004:0.source_cn: 你们这么帮助那个笨熊，对他来说真的是件好事吗？

say:6:1123204005:0.text: Sometimes, it's best for one to suffer the consequences of their foolishness and learn the hard way.
say:6:1123204005:0.source_cn: 有时候适当让他为自己的愚蠢付出代价，更有助于他的成长。

choice_prompt:7:1123204005.text: Sometimes, it's best for one to suffer the consequences of their foolishness and learn the hard way.
choice_prompt:7:1123204005.source_cn: 有时候适当让他为自己的愚蠢付出代价，更有助于他的成长。

say:8:1123204006:0.text: What are you on about? Look around. I can tame most of the beasts in this desert.
say:8:1123204006:0.source_cn: 什么话，放眼看过去这片沙漠，大部分的野兽都能被我驯服，...

say:10:1123204007:0.text: So that means there are some beasts that can't be tamed! What are they?
say:10:1123204007:0.source_cn: 那就是说！还有不能被驯服的啦！是什么呢？

say:11:1123204008:0.text: When you reach my age, you'll realize you shouldn't speak so confidently.
say:11:1123204008:0.source_cn: 等你到了我这个年纪，就清楚话都不能说太满了。

say:12:1123204009:0.text: Hold on, you're the one they call <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:12:1123204009:0.male: Hold on, you're the one they call <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:12:1123204009:0.female: Hold on, you're the one they call <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:14:1123204010:0.text: How do you know the magister's name?
say:14:1123204010:0.source_cn: 咦？你居然知道主人的名字。
say:14:1123204010:0.male: How do you know the magister's name?
say:14:1123204010:0.female: How do you know the magister's name?

say:15:1123204011:0.text: All of the Grimmaw Clan know this name. I do not judge your actions, but how will you compensate me for my tent?
say:15:1123204011:0.source_cn: 黑嚎氏族没人不清楚这个名字。\n我对你做了什么并不评价...
say:15:1123204011:0.male: All of the Grimmaw Clan know this name. I do not judge your actions, but how will you compensate me for my tent?
say:15:1123204011:0.female: All of the Grimmaw Clan know this name. I do not judge your actions, but how will you compensate me for my tent?

say:17:1123204012:0.text: What?! The magister did nothing wrong!
say:17:1123204012:0.source_cn: 什么！主人明明什么都没做！
say:17:1123204012:0.male: What?! The magister did nothing wrong!
say:17:1123204012:0.female: What?! The magister did nothing wrong!

say:18:1123204013:0.text: Well, since you won't stop pestering me, go and fetch some leather and bone needles from my pack.
say:18:1123204013:0.source_cn: 看者有份，你，去把我背包里的皮革和骨针拿过来。
say:18:1123204013:0.male: Well, since you won't stop pestering me, go and fetch some leather and bone needles from my pack.
say:18:1123204013:0.female: Well, since you won't stop pestering me, go and fetch some leather and bone needles from my pack.

say:19:1123204014:0.text: He's got some nerve! Magister, should we just leave?
say:19:1123204014:0.source_cn: 真是莫名其妙……主人，我们要去吗？
say:19:1123204014:0.male: He's got some nerve! Magister, should we just leave?
say:19:1123204014:0.female: He's got some nerve! Magister, should we just leave?

choice_prompt:20:1123204014.text: He's got some nerve! Magister, should we just leave?
choice_prompt:20:1123204014.source_cn: 真是莫名其妙……主人，我们要去吗？
choice_prompt:20:1123204014.male: He's got some nerve! Magister, should we just leave?
choice_prompt:20:1123204014.female: He's got some nerve! Magister, should we just leave?

say:21:1123204016:0.text: Quit your dawdling! Lend an old man some help!
say:21:1123204016:0.source_cn: 别在这里磨磨蹭蹭的了，快去！
say:21:1123204016:0.male: Quit your dawdling! Lend an old man some help!
say:21:1123204016:0.female: Quit your dawdling! Lend an old man some help!

say:23:1123204015:0.text: Hmph! You seem to be in good spirits. Go on, stop dawdling.
say:23:1123204015:0.source_cn: 哼，还知道笑。\n别磨蹭了，快去。
say:23:1123204015:0.male: Hmph! You seem to be in good spirits. Go on, stop dawdling.
say:23:1123204015:0.female: Hmph! You seem to be in good spirits. Go on, stop dawdling.

say:1:1123205001:1.text: Alright... thanks. Just leave it there. I'll finish this later.
say:1:1123205001:1.source_cn: 哦，放在这吧。我待会再用。

say:2:1123205002:1.text: ... What are you standing around for? You can leave now. You don't need to trouble yourselves with the tent.
say:2:1123205002:1.source_cn: ……还愣在这干嘛，你们可以走了，修帐篷的事就不用你们掺和了。

say:3:1123205003:1.text: This tent was specially made by the Grimmaw Clan. Not many people know how to fix it. Your gawking will only distract me.
say:3:1123205003:1.source_cn: 这是黑嚎氏族特制的帐篷，没几个人会修，你们留下来也只会...

choice_prompt:4:1123205003.text: This tent was specially made by the Grimmaw Clan. Not many people know how to fix it. Your gawking will only distract me.
choice_prompt:4:1123205003.source_cn: 这是黑嚎氏族特制的帐篷，没几个人会修，你们留下来也只会碍手碍脚。

say:5:1123205004:1.text: Hmph... Suit yourselves. Go on, then! Get!

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 我们之后还会再来拜访的

say:0:1123206001:0.text: Magister, is it just me, or was he a little nicer toward the end?
say:0:1123206001:0.source_cn: 主人，是我的错觉吗？总觉得他的态度软化了一点……
say:0:1123206001:0.male: Magister, is it just me, or was he a little nicer toward the end?
say:0:1123206001:0.female: Magister, is it just me, or was he a little nicer toward the end?

say:1:1123206002:0.text: I think the same. We should bring this to Kruger's attention.
say:1:1123206002:0.source_cn: 不是错觉。我想，我们得把这个好消息带给克鲁格了。
say:1:1123206002:0.male: I think the same. We should bring this to Kruger's attention.
say:1:1123206002:0.female: I think the same. We should bring this to Kruger's attention.

say:2:1123207001:0.text: Magister, what's the news with Hashir?
say:2:1123207001:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，有哈什尔的新消息了吗？
say:2:1123207001:0.male: Magister, what's the news with Hashir?
say:2:1123207001:0.female: Magister, what's the news with Hashir?

say:3:1123207002:0.text: Hashir asked us for help gathering his mending tools!
say:3:1123207002:0.source_cn: 哈什尔拜托我们帮他找皮革和骨针了呢！

say:4:1123207003:0.text: I would've never expected Hashir to ask anyone for help... with anything. He's always been self-reliant. This is indeed peculiar...
say:4:1123207003:0.source_cn: 真没想到啊，哈什尔竟然会拜托你们做事。\n他向来做事不...

choice_prompt:6:1123207003.text: I would've never expected Hashir to ask anyone for help... with anything. He's always been self-reliant. This is indeed peculiar...
choice_prompt:6:1123207003.source_cn: 真没想到啊，哈什尔竟然会拜托你们做事。\n他向来做事不求人的。

say:8:1123207004:0.text: He also guided a beast tamer in retrieving his lizard... with the magister's help, of course!
say:8:1123207004:0.source_cn: 他还指导了一个驯兽师找回自己的蜥蜴，当然主人也帮了忙！
say:8:1123207004:0.male: He also guided a beast tamer in retrieving his lizard... with the magister's help, of course!
say:8:1123207004:0.female: He also guided a beast tamer in retrieving his lizard... with the magister's help, of course!

say:9:1123207005:1.text: Is that so? Hashir's expertise in beast taming is renowned among the Grimmaw Clan. He mentored many of us over the years.
say:9:1123207005:1.source_cn: 竟然如此嘛？哈什尔的驯兽技术在黑嚎氏族是数一数二的，也...

say:10:1123207006:1.text: Although he may seem gruff and guarded, there's a kind heart hidden under all those wrinkles.
say:10:1123207006:1.source_cn: 虽然面上看起来蛮横无礼，但其实内心深处是个热心肠的人。

say:11:1123207007:1.text: Anyway, I hope this means his demeanor will continue to improve.
say:11:1123207007:1.source_cn: 不管怎样，都希望他的态度再好一点。

say:12:1123207008:1.text: I actually believe he has slowly come to accept you. In the future, I may ask you to visit Hashir more often.
say:12:1123207008:1.source_cn: 我相信他也在慢慢接受你们了，接下来，也拜托你们常去探望...
